description: Desktop client on the sing-box core (VLESS + Reality) with split routing
notes: The app also updates itself in place. On a Scoop install run 'scoop update shtil-vpn' instead, so Scoop and the app agree on the version.
The build carries no publisher certificate, so Windows Defender may quarantine it: https://narvinir.github.io/shtil-vpn/en/guides/windows-warning/
A subscription key comes from the Telegram bot @RealityVPNBot_bot; two-hour guest access works inside the app with no account at all.
